written.headline: Amazon plans World Product Graph to index global product data for AI agents
written.summary: Amazon has drafted a plan called the World Product Graph to gather information on every product sold across the internet, including by crawling rival websites. The project aims to improve Amazon's AI search accuracy and ensure AI shopping agents rely on its data index.

written.headline: Jensen Huang misled Nvidia leaders about relationship with Alice Huang
written.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang misled Nvidia leaders, including general counsel Tim Teter, about his relationship with Alice Huang. Nvidia's stock fell 5.5% following reports detailing relationships with three women.

written.headline: Congressional Democrats launch inquiry into Nvidia China chip sales and Trump deal
written.summary: Congressional Democrats launched an inquiry into how the Trump administration handled Nvidia's chip sales to China and export licenses. The investigation follows Nvidia's ouster of CEO Jensen Huang and questions a revenue-sharing agreement and political donations.

written.headline: FAA expands SMART AI tool nationwide for air traffic congestion
written.summary: The FAA expanded the use of the SMART AI tool to all 22 centers across the US to help manage air traffic congestion. The agency states that the $875 million system previously helped reroute 180 flights in Washington, DC, saving an average of 10 minutes and nearly 80 gallons of fuel per flight.

written.headline: Moonshot AI restructures to pave way for an IPO
written.summary: Chinese artificial-intelligence startup Moonshot AI is restructuring its corporate setup by deactivating its Cayman holding company and moving investors' stakes to its primary operating entity in China. The move is designed to pave the way for an initial public offering.
